title: Multi-Feature Riemannian Hypergraph for Online Test-Time Adaptation of Motor Imagery Brain-Computer Interface
abstract: arXiv:2608.16134v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In clinical motor imagery brain-computer interface (MI-BCI) decoding, cross-day transferability and online operation remain two critical challenges. Hypergraphs can improve transferability by capturing higher-order sample relationships, yet existing hypergraph-based methods for online emotion recognition neglect the cross-day benefits of Riemannian geometry widely adopted in EEG transfer learning. To bridge this gap, we propose the Multi-feature Riemannian Hypergraph (MRieHy), a framework tailored for online test-time adaptation in MI-BCI decoding that leverages Riemannian geometry to strengthen cross-day transferability. MRieHy first computes Riemannian means of covariance matrices from cross-day training data to align multi-day distributions. translated_title: 多特征黎曼超图用于运动想象脑机接口的在线测试时自适应
translated_abstract: 在临床运动想象脑机接口（MI-BCI）解码中，跨天可迁移性和在线操作仍然是两个关键挑战。超图通过捕捉高阶样本关系可以提高可迁移性，但现有的基于超图的在线情绪识别方法忽视了脑电迁移学习中广泛采用的黎曼几何所带来的跨天优势。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了多特征黎曼超图（MRieHy），这是一种专为MI-BCI解码中的在线测试时自适应设计的框架，利用黎曼几何增强跨天可迁移性。MRieHy首先计算跨天训练数据中协方差矩阵的黎曼均值，以对齐多天分布。然后，它使用黎曼距离在协方差矩阵上构建一个超图，并通过余弦相似度在深度特征上构建第二个超图。这两个超图被融合...
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合黎曼几何与双超图融合的新框架MRieHy，以在线测试时自适应方式显著提升运动想象脑机接口的跨天解码性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MRieHy, a novel framework integrating Riemannian geometry with dual hypergraph fusion to significantly enhance cross-day decoding performance in motor imagery brain-computer interfaces via online test-time adaptation.
